_doc: Projects that previously received a tier from the legacy v1 algorithm which the documented v2 evidence rules (docs/SCORING.md) reject. legacy_* values are copied from REAL v1-legacy snapshots in the production hypebot.db (snapshot ids given; exported 2026-10-26). input_file is the real X dataset in tests/fixtures/x_ingest/ for the same project. expected_* is the CURRENT documented v2 outcome (same as tests/regression_expectations.json). These are NOT user-confirmed ground-truth tiers: no manual review exists in the DB (manual_reviews is empty). The v1 snapshot is not guaranteed to be byte-identical input to input_file; the reason column cites the metric that the v1 snapshot itself recorded.

cases.name: Brixes
cases.reason: v1 gave Tier 2 / High confidence from 2 official posts; v2 caps confidence Low below 3 posts, so no tier can be assigned

cases.name: GigaLegendsLTD
cases.reason: v1 gave Tier 2 / High from ONE viral post (100% of engagement); a single viral post cannot rank

cases.name: Minehood
cases.reason: v1 gave Tier 3 then Tier 1 for identical recorded metrics (inconsistent); v2 is deterministic: Tier 2 (49% wallet-address replies keep community below max)

cases.name: Nuloraio
cases.reason: tier unchanged, but v1 claimed High confidence while 87% of engagement sat in one post; v2 caps at Medium
